notes.title: Cross-Play Multiplayer Mayhem
notes.notes: On March 14 there will be a Cross-Play Mayhem Mutliplayer event for Honor and Duty: D-Day. Starting at 20:00 GMT / 15:00 EST.

notes.title: Lockdown Multiplayer Play Event
notes.notes:
[b]Lockdown Multiplayer Play Event[/b]

This Sunday (January 31st) we will fill up the multiplayer lobbies, starting at 21:00 GMT. Players from all platforms are invited to play. 
Developers of Strange Games Studios, including the lead developer Reggie, will also participate in this lockdown multiplayer event.

So when does it start:
[b]Sunday January 31st, 21:00 GMT / 22:00 CET.[/b]

You can find the latest news on r/honoranddutydday

See you on the battlefield soldiers! ːinsfistː
